text_simplified: This text addresses the topic of disciplining and teaching children, emphasizing the importance of gentle guidance over hitting or violence. It indicates that proper tarbiyah (upbringing) is based on wisdom and patience, and that physical punishment is not an effective method. It advises parents to use positive approaches to reinforce good behavior.
